notes.GLP1-031-PCP-001:
PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 01/20/2026

S: 34 y/o F would like to lose weight; back pain better with PT. Drinks 2–3 sweetened coffee drinks and a soda daily; eats out for lunch. Her company just launched a weight management benefit.

O: Wt 97.6 kg, Ht 168 cm, BMI 34.6. BP 114/78.

1. Obesity, BMI 34.6 — plan starting today:
 - Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie diet, target ~1800 kcal/day; cut sugar-sweetened drinks.
 - Gym sessions (treadmill + light weights) 4 days a week, ~150 min/week.
 - Enrolling in the employer-sponsored weight management program with monthly coaching.
 Follow-up visits planned.
2. Low back pain — improving; continue home exercises.
